signals.text: A standing order repays a private loan to Andrea Widmer.
On average 250.82 was left per month over the last 6 months; in 3 months more went out than came in (2026-05, 2026-06, 2026-10).
Sparkonto holds 4'919.20, 49 % of its goal "Notgroschen CHF 10'000".
Steuerverwaltung des Kantons Bern is due on 30.11.2026: 1'180.00, "Steuern 2026, 3. Rate (provisorisch)".
Paid into pillar 3a in 2026: 3'300.00 of the maximum 7'258.00; after the standing orders 3'658.00 is missing.
6 payments of together 3'155.45 are due in the next 30 days.
Regular payments that cost more within a year: KPT Krankenkasse AG from 296.80 to 399.40 on 24.12.2025.
On 23.12.2026, the day before the next salary, 5'363.93 is left on Privatkonto after 6 payments, 198.66 a day. A month's spending is about 5'395.90.
Spending averaged 5'511.93 a month over the last 6 months, highest in 2026-06.
6 payments of together 3'155.45 leave before the salary on 24.12.2026.
The 6 largest monthly payments add up to 2'103.25 a month.

hero_question.reason: The hero shows her Sparkonto at 4'919, i.e. 49.2% of the 10'000 Notgroschen goal with +250 per month, which is the most direct answer the data holds to how her emergency fund gets to 10'000.

about_customer.reason: The tax bill and the monthly tax spending are real signals from Jana's life, but neither is about the request of building the emergency fund to 10'000, and on a requested board a strong signal that is not about the request does not belong.

titles.reason: 'Monthly spending' does not match its tile, which shows only payments to the Steuerverwaltung averaging 273.78 a month, so a demo audience would misread it as her total monthly outgoings, and 'Sparkonto' says nothing of the goal progress the tile shows.

not_empty_or_repeated.reason: Every tile carries a real nonzero figure and no two tiles show the same thing, since the bill is one upcoming payment while the spending tile is a twelve-month average.

coherent.reason: The board does not stay on the request: after the savings-goal hero it drifts into her tax bill and her tax spending, which together tell her nothing about how the emergency fund reaches 10'000.
